title: Never Split the Difference
author: Chris Voss
summary: Former FBI hostage negotiator Chris Voss explains techniques such as mirroring, labelling emotions and calibrated questions. He applies them to salary talks, deals and daily disagreements, with stories from his career.
readIf: you want practical negotiating tactics presented through real stories.
skipIf: you prefer academic negotiation theory or are wary of scripted techniques.
